title: The Soul's Journey and Trial in the Natural
summary: The soul's actual passage through the natural mind. T81 describes how precious truths are formed in the natural like pearls in the sea, and how the soul is settled or disturbed by what comes into it. T82 tells how the soul in trial finds rest only in the Lord's illumining truth, with no gate open in any other power. T83 maps the four ways that rise toward life and the eight ways that descend into corruption. T84 expounds why the elements were put into bodies and bound to the cross of light — to be stripped of their defiled garments. T85 names the three states of perception that bear influx (love, truth, thought) and how the proprium is stripped from each. T86 shows the pure soul as a tilled field drawn upward by likeness.
organizing_principle: The soul's actual passage through the natural mind: from formation in the natural (T81 pearl-in-sea), through trial and the search for rest (T82), the divergent paths upward and downward (T83), the binding to the cross with stripping of garments (T84), the storms of perception with their proprium-cargo (T85), and the final standing of the purified soul as field drawn upward by likeness (T86). A sequence of stages of the journey through the natural toward conjunction.
